description:
hustl. is high-performance period underwear for active girls and women. Performance is our non-negotiable. Every pair is engineered with a blend of natural and synthetic fibres - prioritising look, feel, and function - so you can focus on what matters most: performing at your best, whether that’s on the sports field, on stage, or sprinting for the train to make your 9am presentation.


This isn’t about filling a gap in the market. It’s about removing a barrier. About watching girls and women reach their full potential - unapologetically and uninterrupted - whatever is going on with their body.


We make four styles - an invisible thong for the lightest days, a seamless slip, a secure hipster, and a full short - all with integrated bamboo charcoal pad which is antibacterial, anti-odour and hypoallergenic, with no toxic chemicals like PFAS.


We're looking for genuine UGC. Working out, playing sport, everyday life whilst using our pants, with how they make you feel and how much easier it is, with none of the pain points of getting caught short without a tampon, twisting or moving pads, the packet not rustling in the bathroom cubicle, and the comfort of having period underwear that feels great and doesn't leak.


You earn 20% commission on all sales, paid monthly. We have plenty of customers buying bundles / multiple packs so that can stack up quickly! 30 day cookines included too, so if someone click and decides to come back later - you get that too.
